name: research-pilot
description: Agent-operated research memory for project-based research.

interface.shortDescription: Private research memory for agent-assisted projects.
interface.longDescription: Research Pilot helps Codex-compatible agents initialize and operate a private research workspace where papers, project questions, claims, evidence, limitations, graph deltas, and human decisions accumulate over time. Zotero remains the paper source of truth; graph updates are human-gated.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my project and find missing evidence.
Read this paper in context and propose graph updates.
